scope: Scalar/text and source review; new documentation only. Recommendations are not an execution receipt or a grant.

numerical_findings.finding: Full and incremental endpoint operators disagree materially
numerical_findings.evidence: Call1 full minus incremental E = -1.9693288777489215e-08 Eh; full Fock gradient 2.1796824516403672e-07 versus native 1.2447733711633484e-08.
numerical_findings.inference: A same-density J/VEFF/Fock comparison and full-build iteration pilot are warranted. The exact cause is not proved.

numerical_findings.finding: Repeated ordinary cycles have reached a numerical plateau
numerical_findings.evidence: The final20 cycles of call1 all failed, with approximately2e-10 energy drift; call2 began from a full rebuild but drift resumed.
numerical_findings.inference: More identical iterations are not a demonstrated remedy.

numerical_findings.finding: The observed1.97e-8 Eh mismatch exceeds scalar storage roundoff
numerical_findings.inference: Storage rounding alone cannot explain this mismatch; the earlier water extra-cycle roundoff issue is separate.

existing_control_scope.limitation: Qualifies the fixed-grid derivative construction on water under its explicit full-endpoint certificate; does not certify convergence of the Spinosin native incremental iteration.

finite_energy_noise_design.error_bound: If each of3 energies has absolute error <= epsilon, |delta kappa| <= 4*epsilon/h^2. Consecutive-state energy drift alone is not an absolute error bound.

economical_ordered_tests.name: Small controls for the explicit full-build operator
economical_ordered_tests.work: At identical geometry and density, compare cumulative/incremental and forced-full J, VEFF, Fock, total energy, true occupied-virtual residual and electron count. Then short full-build SCF with finite cycle/CPU bounds. Preserve raw native flags and both consecutive actual densities.
economical_ordered_tests.acceptance: Same physical PBE/def2-SVP/no-D3/full-AO/grid method; no density fitting/in-core ERI/cache change; finite energies and true full unshifted Fock residual satisfy predeclared physical SCF gates. Record norm/max differences, not only booleans.
economical_ordered_tests.why: Separates the operator inconsistency from DIIS/endpoint bookkeeping and tests solver semantics cheaply.

economical_ordered_tests.name: Small native gradient/Hessian consistency
economical_ordered_tests.work: Only after the new control endpoint qualifies, evaluate a fresh native gradient and small native analytic Hessian. Compare selected fixed-grid energy and full-vector gradient central differences at two or more h; retain whole-component and directional errors.
economical_ordered_tests.acceptance: Explicit fresh source endpoint and canonical orbital/energy conventions; preserve original failed water attempts. Same-density Fock/response checks and finite-step convergence are reported separately.
economical_ordered_tests.why: A new SCF policy needs its own derivative control; historical loose-SCF arrays are supporting evidence, not an exact new endpoint reference.

economical_ordered_tests.name: Spinosin zero-point full-operator pilot
economical_ordered_tests.work: Authenticate a specific stopped or source checkpoint and its complete density/MO/grid bindings. Freshly evaluate the actual full operator and gradient residual, then a short finite full-build SCF pilot. A resumed checkpoint is an initial guess, not a completed result.
economical_ordered_tests.acceptance: Full energy AND true unshifted Fock residual, actual consecutive endpoint states, unchanged occupation/electron count and no hidden method/grid change. Stop on a flat full residual before a long retry.
economical_ordered_tests.why: The failed E0 blocks every energy triplet; isolate it before any displacement.

economical_ordered_tests.name: Mode1 common-fixed-grid central energies at multiple h
economical_ordered_tests.work: Share one newly certified E0 across fresh plus/minus pairs at .005 and .0025Bohr; add .01 only if predeclared. Normalize the saved direction in Euclidean Cartesian coordinates; bind q, geometry, units and complete grids by hashes. Use full audited energies and math.fsum.
economical_ordered_tests.acceptance: All real points must complete. Report kappa(h), h-halving change and (if smooth) Richardson estimate with observed noise. Missing pairs remain missing.
economical_ordered_tests.why: Tests the sign discrepancy with larger numerator signal while exposing truncation/noise. The tiny old h is not automatically the most accurate.

economical_ordered_tests.name: Directional derivative and grid-motion separation
economical_ordered_tests.work: After energy qualification, evaluate nuclear gradients only at a selected completed fixed-grid pair and then its halved h if necessary. Compare [gplus-gminus]/(2h) with the full saved Hq and q contraction, and [Eplus-Eminus]/(2h) with q dot fresh g0. On small controls first, compare independently rebuilt atom-centered grids with/without full gradient grid response; consider denser grids.
economical_ordered_tests.acceptance: Keep fixed-original G0 versus rebuilt G(R) as distinct numerical surfaces. Record grid coords/weights/order/count and recompute AO masks at actual geometry. Never treat grid_response=False gradients as the complete derivative of a rebuilt-grid energy.
economical_ordered_tests.why: Distinguishes energy/gradient consistency, electronic response and grid-motion terms from a Hessian assembly hypothesis.

economical_ordered_tests.name: Qualify a molecular minimum before any new full Spinosin Hessian
economical_ordered_tests.work: Once the numerical derivative policy is consistent, measure a fresh nuclear gradient on the intended final surface, qualify GRMS/Gmax and electronic stationary/stability behavior, and optimize further if needed. Check grid-density sensitivity using selected cheap observables. Sample strongest negative mode1, weakest negative25, and positive26 only as diagnosis.
economical_ordered_tests.acceptance: A sampled direction cannot certify or refute all25 imaginary modes. A new signed complete3N-6 analysis at a qualified geometry is eventually required to replace the scientific minimum conclusion. Keep all old25 signed modes unchanged.
economical_ordered_tests.why: An expensive full Hessian at an unqualified/newly shifted endpoint may reproduce a numerical artifact or characterize a nonminimum.

claim_boundaries: The original219-mode computation remains computationally complete with25 imaginary modes,194 positive modes, minimum=false.
A fixed-grid mode1 sign test cannot establish that all25 negative modes are artifacts.
All225 saved-response RHS were measured under the same response operator; this is not an independent proof of H1/partial-A correctness, geometry stationarity or numerical gate satisfaction.
No new frequencies, IR intensities, mechanism verification, experimental assignment, classifier training or classifier-score changes are produced by this audit.
Old closed costs and failures remain preserved; the new prospective72h envelope is managed by root under a separately reviewed guard.
large_artifact_policy: Keep existing large local checkpoint/DM/MO arrays in place. Return scalar summaries, small matrices/plots, source/input/proof hashes and checkpoint references; do not restage all cached raw arrays.
